source.notes: arch-005 (A2 indexed-K1). NSA selected branch: gather the top-k selected block tokens (block_indices*block_size + arange, padded -1 for causally-invisible/surplus slots) and softmax-attend over the gathered set — the typed K1 indexed call (gather_indices operand). The route (top-k over group-mean softmax probs with forced first/current/previous blocks), the compressed branch (mean-pooled K/V), the sliding-window branch, the weighted gated merge (o = g_cmp·o_cmp + g_slc·o_slc + g_swa·o_swa), and the GQA power-of-2/≥16 tile constraint are external. Verified against fla/ops/nsa/naive.py @ 864a87f6. Layer module: architectures/nsa.py.
